feifei_hair_c.png:
A slender chibi SIAMESE cat girl: creamy off-white body fur with a dark seal-brown mask over her muzzle and around the eyes, dark brown ears, paws and tail, bright BLUE almond eyes, narrow face, LARGE pointed ears, small pink blush strokes on her cheeks. She wears a plum-purple short kimono jacket with tied-back sleeves, a black sash, dark leggings, a belt with a row of small bamboo needle-tubes, and a cloth mask hanging loose around her neck.

**HER HAIR - read this carefully, it is the point of this picture.**
She has a tuft of DARK SEAL-BROWN HAIR growing ON TOP OF HER HEAD. It has two parts and BOTH must be visible:
  (1) A FRINGE lying forward over her FOREHEAD, in front of and between her ears, its ragged tips coming down toward her eyebrows. This fringe is on the FRONT of her head and is clearly visible from this angle - it is NOT hidden behind her head. Without it the hair reads as nothing at all.
  (2) Behind the fringe the hair is gathered and tied, and a short spiky PONYTAIL sticks up and back from that tie.
A PLUM-PURPLE ribbon BOW sits at the tie, on the near side of her head, fully visible.
The hair is the same dark seal-brown as her ears and face mask, with a thick black outline like the rest of her. It is drawn as solid flat shapes, not wispy strands.

Pose: standing lightly on her toes, one paw hovering over the needle tubes at her belt, watchful.

Full body, feet at the very bottom edge, filling the frame vertically. Do not draw her floating. Nothing else in the picture: no ground line, no shadow, no scenery, no text, no watermark, no border. Exactly ONE character.
Her muzzle, nose and gaze all point toward the RIGHT edge of the picture - you see the right-hand side of her face and the line of her cheek. She never looks toward the left edge and never looks straight out at the viewer. Her tail trails off to the LEFT behind her.
The attached reference sheet has TWO panels of the SAME cat.
  LEFT panel: she has the hair - **copy the hair from here**: the fringe over the forehead, the tie, the bow, the ponytail. Do NOT copy her pose or the direction she faces.
  RIGHT panel: no hair - **copy the ANGLE from here**: she faces RIGHT in three-quarter view. That is the angle you must draw.
So: the hair of the left panel, on the right panel's right-facing pose.
THE HAIR IS ATTACHED to her head and moves with it. It never detaches, never floats beside her, never swaps to the other side, never appears twice. The bow never floats free of the tie.
THE EYES: both eyes look the same way, same size, same shape - large blue almond eyes with one glossy white highlight each. Never cross-eyed, never one eye bigger or higher.
If any enemy appears, it is a small grey rat or a small orange tabby bandit cat - NEVER another copy of the hero and never anything that looks like him. Enemies stay small and near the edges so the hero is clearly the main subject filling the centre.
Any glow, aura, sheen, sparkle, magical light, mist, smoke, steam, breath, dust cloud, shockwave or water in this picture must be WARM GOLDEN AMBER, CREAMY WHITE or WARM GREY - never green, never greenish - and drawn solid and opaque, never see-through. (The picture sits on a green screen: anything green or transparent gets erased by the chroma key and leaves a hole.)
Style: thick black outlines, FLAT colours with only subtle soft shading - do NOT render it painterly, do NOT use heavy airbrushed shadows or a rendered-illustration look. Cute cartoon, not photorealistic.
THE FACE ESPECIALLY: draw the face in FLAT blocks of colour with hard edges between them. Where two fur colours meet that is a CLEAN EDGE, never a soft airbrushed fade and never a blurry gradient. No shaded blob around the muzzle, no glow on the cheeks.
Background must be a solid pure green (#00FF00), completely flat, for chroma keying.

Output 896x896 PNG. Save the image as feifei_hair_c.png in the current directory and report the path.
